roms.name: LineageOS 23.2 Unofficial II
roms.changelog: April Security Patch. Switched to Pixel Thermal Service. Added Screen Off UDFPS support. Fixed Fast Charging & Disconnecting issue. Blobs updated from latest OnePlus Nord 2 stock ROM (vendor security patch: July 2025). Signed build. Misc improvements. By ManshuTyagi.
roms.changelog_zh: 四月安全补丁。切换到像素热服务。添加了屏幕关闭 UDFPS 支持。修复了快速充电和断开连接问题。从最新的 OnePlus Nord 2 库存 ROM 更新了 Blob（供应商安全补丁：2025 年 7 月）。签名构建。其他改进。作者：ManshuTyagi。

roms.name: Lunaris AOSP 3.8
roms.changelog: Initial release. Added Sony Dolby Atmos (OnePlus UI). Added Warp Charging Overlay. Disabled 6GHz hotspot (broken). Gapps | Userdebug build. SELinux: Enforcing. Signed with release keys. Known bug: Screen Off UDFPS. By Rakhshan.
roms.changelog_zh: 初次发布。添加了索尼杜比全景声（OnePlus UI）。添加了扭曲充电叠加层。禁用 6GHz 热点（损坏）。加普斯 |用户调试构建。 SELinux：强制执行。使用释放密钥签名。已知错误：屏幕关闭 UDFPS。拉克尚.

roms.name: EvolutionX v11.6.1
roms.changelog: Rebranded to op6893. Improved udfps behaviour. Temporarily rolled back some. previous changes(bt, wifi). Synced with latest rom changes. February security patches
roms.changelog_zh: 更名为 op6893。改进了 udfps 行为。暂时回滚了一些。之前的更改（bt、wifi）。与最新的 rom 更改同步。二月安全补丁

roms.name: LineageOS 23.2 Unofficial
roms.changelog: Rebranded to op6893. Switched back to mtk vibrator hal. Fixed video call issues across all major apps. Fixed open and close animations. Misc improvements. By ManshuTyagi.
roms.changelog_zh: 更名为 op6893。切换回 mtk 振动器 hal。修复了所有主要应用程序的视频通话问题。修复了打开和关闭动画。其他改进。作者：ManshuTyagi。

roms.name: Axion AOSP V2.2.1
roms.changelog: Axion AOSP V2.2.1 Nightly. Unofficial GMS build for Cupida (RMX3031) and Denniz. Android 16. Screen off UDFPS now works.
roms.changelog_zh: Axion AOSP V2.2.1 每晚。为 Cupida (RMX3031) 和 Denniz 构建的非官方 GMS。 Android 16。屏幕关闭 UDFPS 现在可以使用。

roms.name: RisingOS Revived 8.1.1
roms.changelog: RisingOS Revived 8.1.1 unofficial build for RMX3031. Android 16.
roms.changelog_zh: RisingOS 恢复了 RMX3031 的 8.1.1 非官方版本。安卓16.

roms.name: Axion AOSP 2.5
roms.changelog: Added Oplus Camera. Non-rooted build. Shipped with Revanced Apps. Clean flash mandatory. By zatvio.
roms.changelog_zh: 添加了 Oplus 相机。非根构建。附带改进的应用程序。强制清洁闪光。通过扎维奥。

roms.name: LineageOS 23.2 Unofficial III
roms.changelog: May Security Patch. Fixed Bottom Speaker for Cupida. Misc Improvements. By ManshuTyagi. GMS build (includes Google Apps).
roms.changelog_zh: 五月安全补丁。丘比特固定底部扬声器。其他改进。作者：ManshuTyagi。 GMS 构建（包括 Google Apps）。

roms.name: LineageOS 23.2 Unofficial III (Vanilla)
roms.changelog: May Security Patch. Fixed Bottom Speaker for Cupida. Misc Improvements. By ManshuTyagi. Vanilla build (no Google Apps).
roms.changelog_zh: 五月安全补丁。丘比特固定底部扬声器。其他改进。作者：ManshuTyagi。 Vanilla 构建（无 Google Apps）。

roms.name: Evolution X 11.7 (Unofficial)
roms.changelog: Improved udfps behaviour. Migrated bt and thermal service to aidl. Updated blobs to latest stock. Resolved most opluscam crashes. Synced with latest rom changes. May security patches. Userdebug, signed, vanilla kernel. By Liwhy.
roms.changelog_zh: 改进了 udfps 行为。将 BT 和热力服务迁移至 AIDL。将 blob 更新为最新库存。解决了大多数 opluscam 崩溃问题。与最新的 rom 更改同步。可能有安全补丁。 Userdebug、签名、普通内核。作者：李维。

roms.changelog: Initial A16 Release . by ManshuTyagi & liwhy1
roms.changelog_zh: 最初的 A16 版本。作者：ManshuTyagi & liwhy1

roms.name: OxygenOS 16 (RMX3031)
roms.changelog: Fastboot package. Extract, boot to fastboot, run flash.bat (Win) or ./flash.sh (Linux). Phone auto-reboots to TWRP. Sideload COS16/OOS16 kernel via ADB, format data, reboot.
roms.changelog_zh: 快速启动包。解压，启动到 fastboot，运行 flash.bat (Win) 或 ./flash.sh (Linux)。手机自动重启至 TWRP。通过 ADB 旁加载 COS16/OOS16 内核、格式化数据、重新启动。

roms.name: Lunaris AOSP 3.10
roms.changelog:
- Initial Official release
- Switched to Motorola Dolby
- Added screen off UDFPS
- Enabled statusbar and ambient mode burn-in Protection
- Fixed camera cutout ring allignment
- Added oneplus camera
- Added display color profiles
- Fixed connected but not charging message

- 首次正式发布
- 切换到摩托罗拉杜比
- 添加了 UDFPS 关闭屏幕

- 添加了显示颜色配置文件
- 修复已连接但未充电消息

roms.name: Evolution X 11.7 (Unofficial) II

- Added a more consistent fp brightness patch
- Cleaned up overlays
- Removed dead powerhint entries
- Resolved some sepolicy denials
- Minor improvements
- Synced with latest rom changes
- May security patches
roms.changelog_zh:
- 修复了 wpa3 wifi 和热点问题
- 添加了更一致的 fp 亮度补丁

roms.name: Axion AOSP 2.7
roms.changelog: Axion AOSP 2.7 Proxima BETA. Updated powerhints. Resolved libperfmgr & sepolicy issues. Disabled 6GHz Wi-Fi support via RRO. Configured SoftAP SAE support. Oplus Camera by @liwhy1. Revanced Apps. Non-rooted build. Dirty flash only over prior zatvio builds. By zatvio.
roms.changelog_zh: Axion AOSP 2.7 Proxima BETA。更新了电源提示。解决了 libperfmgr 和 sepolicy 问题。通过 RRO 禁用 6GHz Wi-Fi 支持。配置 SoftAP SAE 支持。 Oplus 相机，作者：@liwhy1。改进的应用程序。非根构建。脏闪存仅在之前的 zatvio 版本中出现。通过扎维奥。

roms.name: LineageOS 23.2 Unofficial IV (GMS)
